items.docs:
Returns the code and label of all Channable transporters. You should always use one of these standardized transporter codes when submitting an order shipment. If your transporter is not supported already, please contact our support department so we can start supporting it.
Click here to see a table of all transporters |Transporter code|Transporter label| |--|--| |007EX|007EX |2EBOX|2ebox |2GO

Returns the marketplace specific transporters that match the `transporter_code` url parameter.
Expects a Channable transporter code as the `transporter_code` parameter. For a list of valid
transporter codes see the `/transporters/all` endpoint.
